serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: You are the one who said that you may attack me the next time we meet?
Hobo: I did? Wasn’t I just asking for change?
You: No.
You: I saved you from a bunch of kids last time, don’t you remember?
Hobo: That was you? Oh man, you looked a lot more blurry back then.
You: Wha? 
You: Are you joking or…
Hobo: I wish I was, these little shits got me good and then you started screaming at me…
You: Yeah, I don’t think I believe that. 
You: Anyway, are you doing well?
Hobo: Well, as you can see {{wi}}and smell probably… I’m still homeless! No, my situation did not change in a few days.
You: Come on, there’s no need to be so embittered, I was just trying to be nice, you know?
Hobo: So what? I have no use for your kind words. That’s just reality. 
You: With a mindset like that you don’t have many friends, now do you?
Hobo: I had many friends, you know? But these days they are not too fond of paying me a visit. I wonder why.
You: I get it, you got it tough, but treating people like shit will only make things worse, you know?
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: Worse? How can it get worse? That’s the whole point dude, it can’t get worse. 
Hobo: I’m struggling every day to survive, I do stuff I’m not proud of, I beg, I steal, I get beat up, I beat someone up, there’s no end to it!
Hobo: It’s beyond my abilities to imagine things getting even worse!
You: O-ok buddy, my bad…{{wi}} Just… calm down, ok?
I don’t want him to attack me again…{{wi}} I should just leave probably…
#Hobo.Face.normal
Hobo: Sorry, I get easily worked up.
Hobo: So, do you have any other great ideas? 
You: No, I don’t think so…
You: A-anyway, where do you live these days? This area is pretty close to the, you know, no-go zone…
Hobo: I usually move from place to place, but yes, this time I’m coming back from there.
You: W-what?! Isn’t it like, super dangerous?!
Hobo: Where isn't it dangerous these days?
Hobo: With all honesty, it isn’t that bad there. 
Hobo: Sure, it’s full of bad people, gangs, druggies and other scum, but it’s not that bad as people would think.
You: What about the chemical hazards there? Aren’t you scared?
Hobo: Chemical hazards? Are you dumb? It was years ago, there’s no danger now whatsoever. 
You: But what about the wall? The chemical hazard signs at the entry points? Why is no one reforming this place if it’s safe?
Hobo: It’s a ticking bomb bro. Every mayor fights for this zone to stay. What do you think? What would happen if all of these criminals and outcasts just poured into the rest of the city? 
Hobo: Crime rate, unemployment, homelessness and other statistics would go through the roof! For the big guys running the city it’s better this way.
Hobo: As far as the city is concerned, that place doesn’t exist. Together with every nasty aspect around it.
You: T-that’s-!
I-it’s hard to believe… I don’t want to believe it, but…{{wi}} it makes sense…
#Hobo.Face.smile
Hobo: Hahaha! You really are one spoiled brat! You wouldn’t survive a day outside.
…
Hobo: Whatever, I’m done schooling you kid, I have other stuff to do!
Hobo: See ya around!
You: You too…
